name: Demex
rootCause: Nitron, Demex’s lending platform, was exploited on May 16, 2025, through manipulation of the dGLP vault’s oracle, resulting in a $950,559 loss. The attacker inflated the collateral price in a deprecated vault, borrowed real assets against the fake value, and withdrew profits. Recovery efforts reclaimed about $78,000, with the remainder addressed via a restitution token. Demex’s Nitron oracle used a deprecated dGLP vault’s redemption rate for collateral valuation.
